content: Merikɨtsɨ Kakaɨyari Nuhexi kanaye'erieni meta yeutari, tewaxi hamatɨana memɨyetekai kanuwatsie. 'Eka kaniuyuitɨani, waɨkawa tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kaniuku'eka, 'ana haa kanitsutɨani 'etsiwa kawaximetɨ.
Haramara tetɨata haa matineikakai kaneunarixɨani, muyuawitsieta katineunarixɨani, wiyerita katiniuhayewa.
Haa kanikawaximekaitɨni 'anɨari kwiepa. Xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata tukari heutineku, haa waɨkawa kanikawaximekaitɨni.
'Atahuta metseritsie tamamata heimana 'atahuta tukaritsie kanuwa kananutateni 'Ararati hɨriyaritsie.
Haa tsietɨ kanikamiekaitɨni, tamamata metseritsie mexɨakame tukaritsie waɨkawa hɨri petihekɨarixɨa.
Huta tewiyari tukari 'aye'aku, Nuhexi 'itupari 'etsimɨyewa kaneuyepieni kanuwa 'amɨtimariwe kanamikieyatsie mewewiekai,
hikɨ kwatsa kaniutatuani, mɨkɨ mana xeikɨa kaniuwietɨyeikakaitɨni, 'ikwewietɨ haa mɨkawanikɨ.
Tawarita kukuru meutuxa kaniutatuani, timaimɨtɨ xɨka'akuri haa waɨkawa kawatɨyani.
Kukuru kaninuani kanuwatsie memawekaikɨ hakewatsɨ heka'uxipieni haa 'akuxi kwie manukanakaikɨ. Nuhexi yumama kaneutatsera, 'enutuka mana kanuwatsie kaneitatuani.
Tawarita 'atahuta tukari 'anukayaku, hutariekata kukuru kaniutatuani.
Kɨyɨrirɨmekaku kukuru kaninuani, yuyekaraukɨ huriwa yɨrariyari 'atɨtɨ hekwame yurime. 'Anari Nuhexi mɨpaɨ katinetimani kename haa kawatɨyakai kwieri hahekɨakai.
Tawarita 'atahuta tukari kanikakwewieni, hairiekari kukuru kanenɨ'ani, 'anari kukuru pɨkanua.

'Ataxewime tsienituyari heimana xewi wiyari pexeiyakai Nuhexi kepauka haa mukawa. Mexɨakame metseriyaritsie mexɨakame tukaritsie Nuhexi kanuwa 'amɨtimariwe kanamikieya kananutiyepieni meta kwie mɨwakini hepaɨ katinixeiyakaitɨni.
Hutarieka metseritsie xeitewiyari heimana 'atahuta tukaritsie, kwieri waɨkawa kaniwakikaitɨni.
'Anari Kakaɨyari Nuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«Kanuwatsie kenanayeye'ari 'atɨɨriyama, 'a'ɨya, 'amu'e'ema yunaitɨ.
Yaxeikɨata keniwaranaye'ari 'ahamatɨa memɨteye'ɨnekai: memɨte'awɨwawe, tewaxi meta kuterixi. Mekeyumɨiriyani, mekeyuxiɨtɨaka, kwiepa mekehɨneni».
Hikɨ kanuwatsie mekananayekɨne, Nuhexi meta niwemama, 'ɨyaya meta mu'e'emama.
Mekatenanayekɨneta yunaitɨ: tewaxi, memɨte'awɨwawe, metatsiere yunaitɨ kuterixi, meta kwiepa memɨtexuawe yuxexuitɨ yɨkɨ memɨte'anene.
Hikɨ Nuhexi mawari tenutsariyari kaniutawewieni Yawé hetsiemieme, mana katiniwarutitaiya tewaxi memɨmawarɨwa meta memɨte'awɨwawe memɨmawarɨwa.

Kepauka Yawé 'ɨakariyari witsimu'ɨa mu'ukwixɨ mɨpaɨ katiniuyuhɨawe: «Tsepa teɨteri tɨɨriyari paitɨ 'axamemɨteyurie, tawarita kwie 'axanepɨkayurieni tewi ya'ane wiwiekaku. Metatsiere hatsuakuri nepɨkatiwakwini kwiepa memɨtexɨawe, hikɨ kenemɨtiuyuri.
